name: Frankel East
summary: East of Frankel Avenue toward Siglap / Opera — denser landed-edge living with practical east-side hops and community-sport catchment.
body: Frankel East is the shortlist when denser landed-edge living and east-side convenience matter more than quiet landed weekends alone. The pocket sits east of Frankel toward Siglap / Opera edges; housing mixes landed, walk-ups, and selective mid-age condos. Expats land here for car-light hops to Bedok / Eunos and ActiveSG catchment without CBD premiums. Watch-outs: estate LPS inspection calendars, school-run traffic, and confusing Frankel vs Frankel East shortlists. Compare with Siglap Fringe for cafe-edge texture, Opera Estate West for quieter estate living, and Bedok North West when heartland value wins.
